gloss: overtime work; work beyond regular hours

definitions.gloss: overtime work; work beyond regular hours; excess duty
definitions.explanation: Work performed beyond the standard or legally mandated working hours, especially in a formal or administrative context.

examples.japanese: {超過勤務|ちょうかきんむ}が{多|おお}すぎる。
examples.english: There is too much overtime work.

examples.japanese: {超過勤務|ちょうかきんむ}{手当|てあて}は{正|ただ}しく{支払|しはら}われるべきだ。
examples.english: Overtime pay should be paid properly.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}の{超過勤務|ちょうかきんむ}が{上限|じょうげん}を{超|こ}えないよう{管理|かんり}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to manage things so that monthly overtime doesn't exceed the upper limit.

notes:
Composed of {超過|ちょうか} (excess, exceeding) + {勤務|きんむ} (duty, work). A formal, administrative term for overtime. In everyday conversation, {残業|ざんぎょう} is much more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {超過勤務|ちょうかきんむ}{手当|てあて} — overtime pay/allowance
- {超過勤務|ちょうかきんむ}{時間|じかん} — overtime hours
- {超過勤務|ちょうかきんむ}{命令|めいれい} — overtime order (official directive to work overtime)
- {超過勤務|ちょうかきんむ}の{削減|さくげん} — reduction of overtime

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {残業|ざんぎょう} — overtime (everyday term; far more commonly used in conversation)
- {時間外|じかんがい}{労働|ろうどう} — work outside regular hours (legal/labor law term)
- {勤務|きんむ} — work, duty (general term)

REGISTER:
Primarily used in official, administrative, and legal contexts — government documents, labor regulations, and corporate HR materials. In everyday workplace conversation, {残業|ざんぎょう} is strongly preferred.
